A resource lease records its claiming node; a lease read on another node is kept unverified instead of being judged stale by a local PID, and a dead lease on its own node is still pruned. A claim is published whole (temporary file, then hard link), so an unlocked reader mid-claim sees no lease and prunes nothing, and a held slot still refuses a second claim.

The round-signal classifier behind the evidence-gated abort (policy_abort_infrastructure_round_v2) counts only an infrastructure-class failure in the run's own event log since the round's reset as abort evidence. No distinct g012 tool-error or receipt failure shape qualifies. Every Harness-marked receipt fault (execution fault, uncertain write, planner implementation failure, invalid measured state, skill trusted fault, nested stage fault) and every infrastructure tool-error code does. Refusals and behavioural codes do not, earlier rounds do not count, and unreadable lines are not evidence. The EXP11A g013 kernel unit's other-arm refusals (inter_arm_collision:<segment> planner refusals, single-arm, lockstep and after motion started, recovery_inter_arm_collision_path before and during recovery, and a grasp_execute stage refused by the other arm) are not infrastructure signals.

On test-local v2 copies of the RoboTwin, LIBERO and RoboDojo default surfaces (policy_finish_outcomes_v2, policy_abort_infrastructure_round_v2) finish_episode declares exactly success and give_up, plus abort with the abort capability: reason required, category an enum required with give_up, failure and attempts retired, the class list generated from the abort gate's table, no help naming the retired failure exit (recover_pose names the accepted outcomes) and no advice; an empty, token or placeholder reason, a success reason without an observable evidence source and a give_up without a category are refused retryably with the field named before any lifecycle state; success still needs check_task true and latches, and a latched success is refused first (retryable, changed arguments required, field outcome, only success allowed) whatever the other arguments; an unconfirmed success is retryable only while the round is not terminal; abort is admitted only on an infrastructure failure recorded since the round's reset and the record names it, and its refusal is retryable without the changed-arguments flag, lists the counted classes (counted_classes()) and the signals read, and the same abort is admitted once a fault is recorded; the kept released RoboTwin B2 noservo_v1 surface keeps its released contract and admission, and the binders refuse a surface they cannot describe or one declaring the released finish rules. A malformed argument (non-text or structured outcome, reason or category) is a retryable policy refusal and never an internal_tool_error that would admit a later abort; the reason rule counts a CJK character as two characters and half a word and matches evidence sources loosely (check task, task check, checkTask, Chinese equivalents).

A give_up records the plan candidates offered and not tried since the round's reset, read from the event log: by candidate id (grasp_execute, place_execute) on RoboTwin and RoboDojo, by approximate pose match of an accepted move_pose on LIBERO; repeated grasp identities are one candidate, place_plan ids belong to their call, refused calls try nothing, earlier rounds and unreadable lines do not count, the reason is searched for literal untried ids, and a give_up naming untried candidates is admitted and recorded, never refused. An id is reported untried only when no offering of it was tried.

On a v2 finish surface a give_up ends the round as a valid policy-lifecycle sample with its verdict kept, an abort admitted on recorded infrastructure evidence ends only its round at a round-scoped infrastructure boundary with no verdict and an invalid sample, and the session continues; the outcome, category, reason, evidence count and candidate verdict reach the termination_authority_decision event, the round records, result.json and evaluation.json, evaluation accepts an admitted abort round in a completed session and refuses one the record does not support, a single run ended by an admitted abort is incomplete, and a surface without the capability keeps its records exactly.
